evidence.reason: After edit, calls reminders.evaluate(0, 0.1, "benrk") — the minutes parameter is no longer forwarded and the calendar string changed from "work" to "benrk".
New guard `if (minutes === 0) return 0;` short-circuits when evaluate passes 0, which is exactly what the edited scheduledDelay now supplies.

evaluate is the value-reference path to reminderDelay; its handling of the "benrk" calendar and 0 minutes is not supplied, leaving the merged outcome uncertain.
